mapper.select: SELECT * FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status = #{status} AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1 ORDER BY monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_priority ASC, monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_create_time ASC

SELECT * FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status = 'PENDING' AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_mode = 'SCHEDULED' AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_scheduled_time <= #{currentTime} AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1 ORDER BY monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_priority ASC, monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_scheduled_time ASC

SELECT * FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status = 'FAILED' AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_retry_count < monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_max_retry AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1 ORDER BY monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_priority ASC, monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_update_time ASC

SELECT * FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status = 'PROCESSING' AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_start_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks SET monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status = #{status}, monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_start_time = #{startTime}, monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_end_time = #{endTime}, monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_update_time = NOW() WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_id = #{taskId}

UPDATE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks SET monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_retry_count = monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_retry_count + 1, monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_update_time = NOW() WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status as status, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_file_size) as totalSize FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1 AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failedTasks, SUM(monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_file_size) as totalSize FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_create_user = #{createUser} AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1 AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_file_name, '.', -1) as fileType, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_file_size) as totalSize FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1 AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_file_name LIKE '%.%' GROUP BY fileType ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_file_size >= #{minSizeMB} * 1024 * 1024 AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1 ORDER BY monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_file_size DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1 ORDER BY monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_file_md5 = #{fileMd5} AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1 ORDER BY monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failedTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processingTasks, SUM(monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_file_size) as totalSize FROM monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks WHERE DATE(monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_create_time) = CURDATE() AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_tasks SET monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_task_status = 0, monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_update_time = NOW() WHERE monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_create_time < #{expiredTime} AND monitor_sys_gen_file_upload_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
